name: Kaioken Skills
summary: This module loads and parses "skills" — markdown files with YAML frontmatter — from a set of standard directories relative to a repository root. It discovers skill files, extracts their name/description/metadata, and returns a structured list. It also provides a helper to load a single skill by name. The module is structural: it doesn't execute skills, only finds and reads them.
keyPoints: Skill discovery searches a fixed list of standard directories: the Kaioken dir's `skills/`, plus `.agents/skills`, `.pi/skills`, and `.github/skills` under the repo root.
The core loader `loadSkills` returns a `LoadedSkills` object containing skills found across all candidate directories; a per-directory helper `skillsDirs` resolves those candidates from a root.

Each skill is parsed from raw markdown text via `parseSkill`, which reads YAML frontmatter (delimited by `---`) for metadata like `name` and `description`, falling back to a derived default name when one is missing.
A single-skill loader `loadSkill` reads one named skill file from the root, used when you know exactly which skill you need rather than enumerating all.
The module is deliberately read-only and structural — it discovers, reads, and parses skill definitions but contains no logic for executing or applying them.

entryPoints.name: loadSkill
entryPoints.note: Async; loads a single skill by name from a repo root, returning the raw markdown string.

entryPoints.name: loadSkills
entryPoints.note: Async; scans all standard skill directories (SKILLS_DIR plus `.agents`, `.pi`, `.github` under root) and returns structured LoadedSkills.

entryPoints.name: parseSkill
entryPoints.note: Synchronous; parses raw markdown frontmatter into a Skill minus its path, or returns a reason string on failure.

entryPoints.name: skillsDirs
entryPoints.note: Returns the ordered list of candidate skill directories for a root, respecting options that alter the search.

entryPoints.name: skillsDir
entryPoints.note: Returns the Kaioken-specific skills directory for a given root (join(KAIOKEN_DIR, 'skills')).
